RootLayout.title: Online Riddles
RootLayout.description: A lateral thinking puzzle game for groups. Ask yes/no questions, gather clues, and crack the mystery.

HomePage.title: Online Riddles
HomePage.subtitle: A lateral thinking interrogation. Ask the smartest questions, gather the wildest clues, and crack the case together, or go solo for the glory (and the points).

HowToPlay.ideaBody: Each round, one player, the Narrator, knows the solution to a riddle. Everyone else asks yes/no questions and tries to solve the case.
HowToPlay.narratorBody: Answers every question with yes, no, or n/a (not relevant to the solution). Solutions submitted by other players are approved or rejected by the Narrator in the Inbox.
HowToPlay.questionsBody: Every “yes” answer automatically becomes a clue. All questions (including the no's and n/a's) can be reviewed in the Interrogation log.
HowToPlay.solveBody: Think you know the answer? Submit a solution. The Narrator sees it first and approves or rejects it. Other players only see what you submitted once it's correct.
HowToPlay.pointsBody: A harder case earns more points. The player who solves it and the Narrator both get a bonus, as does the round's best question. A wrong guess costs points.
HowToPlay.hardcoreBody: Optional, set by the host: every wrong guess costs the whole team 1 life. At 0 lives, it's game over for the whole session.
HowToPlay.corkboardBody: A shared board to pin clues and theories and connect them with threads. Desktop/tablet only, not available on phones.
